blocks.text: This Non-Disclosure Agreement (the **Agreement**) is made on the {{document.issue_date_legal}}.

blocks.title: Parties
items: **{{company.legal_name_with_associates}}**, having its registered office at {{company.address_inline}} (the **Company**), OF THE FIRST PART;
AND
**{{worker.full_name}}**, residing at {{worker.address_inline}} (the **{{engagement.party_term}}**), OF THE SECOND PART.

blocks.title: Background
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} is engaged by the Company as {{role.title}} from {{employment.start_date_long}}, and will receive Confidential Information for the purpose of performing that role (the **Permitted Purpose**).
In consideration of the engagement and of the Confidential Information made available, the parties agree as follows.

blocks.title: Confidential Information
items: **Confidential Information** means information, in any form, that is not public and that the {{engagement.party_term}} receives or creates through the engagement, including:
(a) business plans, strategies, forecasts and financial information;
(b) customer, client, supplier and partner information;
(c) personal data about employees, customers or other people;
(d) software, source code, algorithms, designs, data models and technical documentation;
(e) products, product roadmaps, research and unreleased work;
(f) pricing, contracts and commercial terms;
(g) marketing, sales and growth plans;
(h) know-how, processes and methods of working;
(i) security arrangements, credentials and access methods;
(j) information about the Company's associated companies;
(k) any information marked confidential, or that a reasonable person would treat as confidential.
Confidential Information does **not** include information that:
(a) is or becomes public other than through a breach of this Agreement;
(b) the {{engagement.party_term}} lawfully knew before receiving it from the Company;
(c) the {{engagement.party_term}} lawfully receives from a third party who owes no duty of confidence;
(d) the {{engagement.party_term}} develops independently, without using Confidential Information, Company equipment or Company time;
(e) the Company agrees in writing may be disclosed.

blocks.title: Obligations of Non-Disclosure
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} must keep Confidential Information secret and secure, use it only for the Permitted Purpose, and not copy, remove or transfer it outside Company systems unless authorised.
The {{engagement.party_term}} may disclose Confidential Information only:
(a) to colleagues or advisers who need it for the Permitted Purpose and owe a duty of confidence;
(b) with the Company's prior written consent; or
(c) where required by (i) law, (ii) a court order, (iii) a regulator or (iv) a competent authority — and then only what is required, telling the Company first where the law allows.

blocks.title: Non-Solicitation
items: This clause applies during the engagement and for {{company.nda_non_solicit_months}} months after it ends.

blocks.title: Return of Confidential Information
items: When the engagement ends, or earlier on request, the {{engagement.party_term}} must return all Company property and Confidential Information, delete it from personal devices and accounts, and confirm this in writing if asked.

blocks.title: Notices
items: Notices under this Agreement are given in writing to the Company at {{company.address_inline}}, and to the {{engagement.party_term}} at {{worker.address_inline}} or the e-mail address held by the Company.

blocks.title: Representations
items: Each party confirms that it is free to enter into this Agreement.

blocks.title: Duration and Termination
items: The obligations of confidentiality continue {{company.confidentiality_duration}} after the engagement ends, unless the information ceases to be confidential.

blocks.title: Assignment
items: The {{engagement.party_term}} may not assign this Agreement. The Company may assign it to an associated company or a successor.

blocks.title: Amendments
items: A change to this Agreement is valid only if it is in writing and signed by both parties.

blocks.title: Governing Law
items: This Agreement is governed by {{company.governing_law}}.

blocks.title: General Provisions
items: If any part of this Agreement cannot be enforced, the rest continues to apply. This Agreement, with the Employment Contract, is the whole agreement between the parties on confidentiality.
